description: This file defines a Polygon class extending Polyline for drawing polygon overlays on maps, including methods for calculating center, converting latlngs, clipping points, and checking point containment. It also exports a factory function for creating polygons.

classes.name: Polygon
classes.description: A class for drawing polygon overlays on a map, extending Polyline with additional methods for center calculation, point conversion, clipping, and containment.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the polygon has no points.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates the geographic center of the polygon based on its vertices.

methods.name: _convertLatLngs
methods.description: Converts and possibly removes duplicate last point if it equals the first.

methods.name: _setLatLngs
methods.description: Sets the latitude/longitude points for the polygon.

methods.name: _defaultShape
methods.description: Returns the default shape of the polygon based on its points.

methods.name: _clipPoints
methods.description: Clips the polygon points to the map bounds for rendering.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Updates the polygon path on the renderer.

methods.name: _containsPoint
methods.description: Determines if a point is inside the polygon using ray casting.
